tasks.short: Review interview answers for missing information, recording errors and inconsistencies.

steps.what: Retrieve interview answers and the applicable questionnaire instructions.
Check required fields, dates, allowed values and questionnaire branching.
Compare narrative answers with interview notes and flag possible recording errors.

loop.input: Interview answers, available interview notes and validation findings.
loop.output: Possible contradictions or omissions, each linked to its source passage.
loop.check: Require source references; interviewer accepts or rejects each proposed clarification. Never infer missing answers.
loop.stop: One comparison pass and one repair pass per questionnaire; unsupported findings go to manual review.
loop.why_not_simpler: Rules catch field errors but cannot reliably compare differently phrased narrative answers.

steps.what: Ask the respondent to resolve missing answers and meaningful contradictions.
Save confirmed corrections and mark the questionnaire reviewed.

tasks.design: Configure validation and a review queue in the {WORKFLOW}, linked to questionnaires in the {DOCS} and records in the {HCM}. A bounded comparison loop proposes source-linked questions; the interviewer resolves ambiguity with the respondent and approves corrections before saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Questionnaire versions, interview notes and records are separate. Narrative consistency checks resist simple field rules.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing form validation handles routine checks. AI-assisted coding makes connectors and comparison tools cheaper to build; bounded text comparison helps with narrative exceptions.
tasks.still_hard: Notes may be incomplete. Consistent answers can still be factually wrong, and sensitive contradictions require a conversation.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when an apparent error reflects uncertainty, misunderstanding or a sensitive disclosure.

ambition.what: Choose questionnaire wording changes from a weekly review of recurring clarification reasons.

tasks.altitude: The week shifts from checking every field to resolving exceptions and improving question wording. The interviewer can propose wording changes; approval rights remain with the questionnaire owner.

reach.learn: Question design, field definitions and how downstream records use each answer.

evidence.claim: AFAS supports employee self-service changes flowing into HR and payroll records.
Source-linked narrative comparison is a proposed design; the digest contains no direct interview-review case.

assumptions: The baseline is employee questionnaire review in a mid-size European HR team.
Time shares and remaining time are planning estimates, not measured results.
A review checks recording quality and completeness; it does not prove the respondent's statements.
Access review and employee consultation under national rules, where applicable, are included in the access range.
unknowns: Questionnaire formats, volumes and version controls.
Whether interview notes are retained and accessible.
Available interfaces and permissions in the {HCM} and {DOCS}.
Applicable national consultation requirements and local review responsibilities.
research_questions: How reliably can narrative contradictions be detected without inventing missing information?
Which existing form controls can express branching and cross-field validation?
new_work: Maintain questionnaire versions and validation rules.
Sample accepted records for missed errors.
Maintain permissions, retention settings and connector failures.

tasks.short: Compile interview answers, apply questionnaire codes and file the results.

steps.what: Assemble reviewed answers and the current questionnaire codebook.
Transcribe answers from notes or completed forms into the result template.

loop.input: Reviewed answer forms and the result template.
loop.output: Structured answers with a source passage for each extracted field.
loop.check: Copy structured fields directly; validate types and completeness. Interviewer reviews narrative extraction and unreadable fields.
loop.stop: One extraction pass and one repair pass per form; unresolved fields remain blank for manual entry.
loop.why_not_simpler: Direct mapping handles digital fields, but variable notes and free-text forms require bounded extraction.

steps.what: Assign questionnaire codes to answers and resolve ambiguous classifications.

loop.input: Accepted structured answers and a versioned questionnaire codebook.
loop.output: Suggested codes with supporting passages and an unresolved category.
loop.check: Use exact mappings first. Reject codes outside the codebook; interviewer approves narrative classifications.
loop.stop: One classification pass per answer; ambiguous or unsupported mappings go to the interviewer without repeated guessing.
loop.why_not_simpler: Fixed choices map deterministically; open answers can express the same category in many ways.

steps.what: Enter accepted coded answers into the employee record.
File source forms and link them to the result record.

tasks.design: Use the {WORKFLOW} to collect answers once, apply exact code mappings and link source forms in the {DOCS}. Bounded extraction and classification loops handle legacy forms and narrative answers, with interviewer approval before a deterministic connector writes accepted results to the {HCM}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Forms and codebooks differ across teams. Moving answers into records is repetitive, while narrative coding needs interpretation.
tasks.enabler_now: Configured forms remove much transcription. AI-assisted coding reduces connector effort, and constrained models can propose codes from a supplied codebook.
tasks.still_hard: Poor source notes, changing category definitions and inconsistent human coding limit quality. Historical records may need separate migration work.
tasks.human_edge: Preserve the respondent's meaning and challenge categories that erase important distinctions.

ambition.what: Provide a monthly anonymised report on recurring employee questionnaire themes.

tasks.altitude: The interviewer spends less time copying and filing, and more time resolving difficult coding cases. They can recommend codebook revisions; decisions about employee outcomes remain with authorised HR roles.

reach.task: Identify recurring learning needs from employee questionnaires.
reach.learn: Theme analysis, aggregation thresholds and the difference between a reported need and a training recommendation.

evidence.claim: AFAS demonstrates self-service HR record changes; it does not establish automatic narrative questionnaire coding.
Rossum demonstrates document extraction, validation and exception routing in order processing, an adjacent pattern.
The proposed extraction and coding review times require a local pilot.

assumptions: Codes describe questionnaire answers, not applicant suitability, employee performance or eligibility.
Reviewed answers come from the preceding quality-review task; factual clarification is not repeated here.
Time shares and remaining time are estimates for mixed digital forms and narrative notes.
Build ranges assume reuse of shared form and review components; task ranges are not additive.
Access and applicable consultation under national rules are included; local procedures can extend elapsed time.
unknowns: Current codebook, coding disagreements and ownership of category definitions.
Proportion of structured answers versus narrative or handwritten forms.
Whether the {HCM} accepts imports with source links and duplicate protection.
Permitted purposes, retention periods and reporting group sizes.
research_questions: How closely do proposed codes match independently reviewed human coding?
Which codes can be assigned through exact mappings alone?
new_work: Review extracted answers and ambiguous codes.
Maintain codebook versions and exact mappings.
Monitor failed writes and duplicate records.
Check that aggregate reports do not expose individuals.

tasks.short: Answer patient service calls, explain administrative information and route medical or financial questions.

steps.what: Answer the call, establish the request and verify identity when needed.
Find authorised administrative details in the patient administration system and guidance.
Explain routine administrative information and clarify what help the patient needs.
Select the appropriate clinician or billing specialist and make a warm handover.
Record the contact outcome and agreed follow-up in the patient administration system.

tasks.design: Connect the {TELEPHONY} to an authorised administrative view of the patient administration system in {OTHER}, with approved guidance from the {DOCS}. Configure referral choices and contact templates in the {WORKFLOW}; the interviewer keeps the conversation, specialist handover and approval of the contact record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Patient details, guidance and referral contacts sit in separate places. Staff must search while supporting someone who may be distressed.
tasks.enabler_now: Read-only connectors, indexed guidance and configured contact templates are established technology. AI-assisted coding can reduce implementation effort without requiring automated medical interpretation.
tasks.still_hard: Identity checks, health-data access and specialist availability remain demanding. A service interviewer cannot resolve clinical questions or negotiate financial exceptions without the relevant authority.
tasks.human_edge: Notice distress, explain patiently and ensure that a vulnerable person reaches an accountable specialist.

ambition.what: Provide scheduled assisted callbacks for patients who cannot complete digital administration.

tasks.altitude: Less call time goes into searching and repetitive records, leaving more capacity for difficult conversations and assisted callbacks. Clinical and financial decision rights do not change.

reach.task: Create service training for sensitive patient conversations.
reach.learn: Accessible communication, referral protocols and the boundary between administration and clinical advice.

evidence.claim: TOPdesk Robin retrieves knowledge-base answers and creates pre-filled requests, an adjacent service-desk pattern.
Administrative retrieval and contact templates can support a human conversation without a model loop.
Health information requires special-category data safeguards under GDPR.

assumptions: This occupational task applies to a patient-facing employer or service unit; it is not typical internal HR work.
Where no patient service exists, this task is outside the local role.
The interviewer provides administrative assistance and routes clinical or financial decisions to authorised specialists.
The design uses no call recording, emotion analysis or model access to clinical records.
Time estimates preserve substantial human conversation, consistent with the task's high relationship and harm sensitivity.
The access range includes health-data permissions and consultation under national rules where applicable.
unknowns: Whether the employer has a patient-facing service unit.
Patient administration interfaces and permitted administrative fields.
Identity verification, urgent escalation and referral procedures.
Availability of clinicians, billing specialists and accessible callback arrangements.
Applicable national consultation and health-sector requirements.
research_questions: Can administrative context be retrieved without exposing clinical details?
Which routine questions already have approved, accessible guidance?
new_work: Maintain approved guidance and referral contacts.
Review and complete templated contact records.
Handle failed lookups and unavailable specialists.
Manage callback queues and audit health-data access.

tasks.short: Help people understand and complete HR applications or questionnaires.

steps.what: Select the correct form and check which supporting information is needed.
Explain unfamiliar questions and the form's completion instructions.

loop.input: The respondent's question, selected form and approved completion instructions.
loop.output: A plain-language explanation with references to the applicable instructions.
loop.check: Show approved field help first. Interviewer reviews novel explanations; unsupported questions are escalated.
loop.stop: One draft and one repair attempt per question; missing guidance triggers human help.
loop.why_not_simpler: Configured help covers standard questions; unfamiliar phrasing and contextual questions need bounded language interpretation.

steps.what: Help the respondent express answers and obtain missing supporting information.
Check required fields and attachments before reading the form back.
Read back the completed answers and obtain the respondent's confirmation.
Send the confirmed form to the responsible HR team.

tasks.design: Configure accessible forms in the {WORKFLOW}, with branching, attachment checks and approved help from the {DOCS}. A bounded answer desk drafts explanations for the interviewer, while the respondent confirms answers before routing to the {HCM}; assisted completion remains available.
tasks.previous_blocker: Static forms expose every question at once, and guidance is separate. Staff repeatedly explain the same fields and forward completed documents.
tasks.enabler_now: Configured branching, validation and routing already handle routine completion. AI-assisted coding lowers the effort of connecting them, while bounded drafting helps explain unfamiliar wording.
tasks.still_hard: Language barriers, disability, low literacy and sensitive disclosures require adaptable human help. A form cannot supply evidence or decide what the respondent means.
tasks.human_edge: Help someone give their own answer without steering it, and recognise when they need a different form of support.

ambition.what: Offer assisted remote completion appointments for shift workers unable to attend daytime HR desks.

tasks.altitude: The week contains fewer routine explanations and submission checks, with more scheduled support for difficult cases. The interviewer gains capacity to organise assisted sessions; eligibility and employment decision rights do not change.

reach.learn: Accessible form design, assisted digital support and internal routing requirements.

evidence.claim: AFAS demonstrates employee self-service changes feeding HR and payroll processes.
TOPdesk Robin demonstrates knowledge-based answering with handover through a pre-filled request.
Accessible branching forms and respondent confirmation can reduce completion support; the estimated savings are unvalidated.

assumptions: The baseline covers internal employee applications and questionnaires, not loan or public-benefit eligibility.
The mailbox is used for final routing, not assumed to dominate the whole task.
Live completeness checks here precede the separate detailed review of interview accuracy.
Respondent confirmation authorises submission; it is not treated as GDPR consent or an employment decision.
Time shares and remaining time are planning estimates.
The access range includes consultation under national rules where applicable.
unknowns: Actual form types, languages and accessibility needs.
Existing self-service, branching and help capabilities.
Who may assist, confirm and submit each form.
Which attachments are necessary and how long they must be retained.
Demand and staffing availability for remote assisted appointments.
research_questions: Which approved field explanations resolve most questions without model drafting?
Can users with different accessibility needs complete and confirm the configured forms?
new_work: Maintain form versions, branching and approved explanations.
Provide assisted sessions and resolve missing evidence.
Monitor abandoned forms, failed submissions and accessibility problems.

role.altitude: The role shifts from copying, checking and forwarding forms toward assisted interviews, exception resolution and clearer questionnaires. Employment, clinical and financial decisions remain with authorised specialists.
reach: Help human resources specialists improve employee intake using recurring clarification reasons.
Help training and development specialists identify aggregate learning needs from questionnaire themes.
Help human resources assistants provide accessible self-service and assisted completion.
skills_to_grow: Accessible interviewing and neutral question phrasing.
Form validation, codebook design and exception handling.
GDPR purpose limitation, access control and retention.
Basic workflow configuration and connector monitoring.
role.ambitious_version: Run an accessible interview and questionnaire support service that combines self-service intake with scheduled human assistance, and uses aggregate completion problems to improve forms.
